name: GCP — Project IAM Bindings
description: Pull GCP project IAM policy bindings as cloud entitlements (role-to-member assignments) for CIEM analysis

steps.instruction: Open GCP Console → IAM & Admin → Service Accounts
Create a new service account (or select an existing one) and grant the 'IAM Viewer' or 'Project IAM Admin' role at the project level
Click the service account → Keys → Add Key → Create new key → JSON, then open the downloaded file
Copy the value of 'private_key' (the full PEM block including headers)

validation_request.error_message: Could not retrieve IAM policy for the GCP project. Verify the service account has the IAM Viewer (roles/iam.viewer) or resourcemanager.projects.getIamPolicy permission.

transform.expr: {'cloud_provider': 'gcp', 'resource_type': 'iam_binding', 'entitlement_kind': 'role_assignment', 'role': record.get('role', ''), 'role_kind': ('predefined' if str(record.get('role', '')).startswith('roles/') and not '/projects/' in str(record.get('role', '')) else 'custom'), 'members': record.get('members', []) or [], 'user_members': [m[5:] for m in (record.get('members') or []) if str(m).startswith('user:')], 'service_account_members': [m[15:] for m in (record.get('members') or []) if str(m).startswith('serviceAccount:')], 'group_members': [m[6:] for m in (record.get('members') or []) if str(m).startswith('group:')], 'has_all_users': any(m in ('allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers') for m in (record.get('members') or [])), 'condition_title': (record.get('condition', {}) or {}).get('title', ''), 'condition_expression': (record.get('condition', {}) or {}).get('expression', '')}
True if any(m in ('allUsers', 'allAuthenticatedUsers') for m in (record.get('members') or [])) else False
